mandate: Owner request 2026-10-17: 'We need a clearer visual signal in panes when data is not yet ready... especially true of the overview page when opening a PR.' One base loading-state pattern for every pane waiting on data, from real pending state, reduced motion, screen readers, four themes, no layout jumps; documented in docs/ux as the standard; Overview-on-open primary with a before/after frame sequence; one Accept/Reject in the same fresh session as BPR-1575; separate commits; park on main.
governing_rfc: RFC-BPR-0028 (empty, loading and failure states); RFC-BPR-0032 Home; RFC-BPR-0031 motion

decisions.core: core::decide_pending_look over {activity, has content, partial, elapsed} with 400 ms reveal and 6 s slow marks, busy/turning/veiled/retry helpers, announcement rules and the next wake.
decisions.qt: qt::pending_veil laid over a pane (never in its layout) and qt::pending_mark for lines that already speak.
decisions.motion: Turning follows the system observation (full or unsupported turns; reduced, unknown or failed stays still); the Dif motion selector stays the mascot's.
decisions.overview_trace: Before: Home 'Opening' until GitHub answers, then the Overview title/description with an empty file table and dashes in the side column until the accepted review (about 5 s with the file list held 3 s); switching pull requests the same. After: each section waits in its own place; the file table shows one placeholder row per reported file; slow words name the read's step; the Overview announces once when ready. The whole snapshot is accepted atomically, so files, side column and checks arrive together; comment counts and images later.
decisions.not_done: Home's existing row and band turning marks (BPR-1357) still animate regardless of Reduce Motion; the Files drawer only waits during a first read (after it, an empty catalogue is real).
